comment: Keycloak does not list the credential scopes (client scopes of the oid4vc protocol) in scopes_supported of its authorization server metadata. The server is permitted to not advertise scopes it supports.

current-block: Try DPoP proof expecting Scheme based normalization of htu claim, where the port is not considered if that is the default for the scheme.
comment: Keycloak's credential endpoint does not apply scheme based normalization (RFC 3986 6.2.3) when comparing the htu claim of a DPoP proof.
